future_registration_contract.storage: Future actual output/journal/log directories must be assigned under the user's modelTeam/liberai-tmp/liulu storage, with code and lightweight receipts under personal code/liulu. This note allocates no real run directory.
future_registration_contract.runtime: Original raw request CPU_python (frozen_ldpc_py311); CUDA hidden; two CPU threads and two assigned CPU affinity entries. No real runtime is constructed by import or metadata validation.

source_identity.selection: Authenticated original calibration1000 ranked by contract.select_cal200; selection_slot is 0..199 and supplies the public counter.
source_identity.arrays: Original uint8 CHW 3x256x256 pixels and int64 680 tokens are independently authenticated against migrated archive pins and original source checkpoints. No token generation is requested.
source_identity.raw_receiver_internal_phase: The unchanged original raw Receiver ledger API requires phase='raw_holdout'; this legacy internal API string does not identify the experiment population. New physical input identities, event_prefix and records explicitly identify LAYERED_RAW_CAL200_V1 and cal200. The original common500 source loader is never called.

physical_and_logical_identity.physical: One actual TX-channel-RX event for each distinct source/hat/canonical physical candidate/true SNR/noise seed.
physical_and_logical_identity.logical: One score-facing row per canonical candidate and receiver rule. Arms and nomination_indices are alias metadata and do not increase the quality denominator.
physical_and_logical_identity.single_views: KEEP and DROP are derived from the same raw433 actual event; DROP never repeats packet decoding. Original KEEP actual receiver state is preserved.
physical_and_logical_identity.grouped_views: DROP only, including wrong but valid old single-group profile IDs parsed inside the mixed public catalogue.
physical_and_logical_identity.receiver_domains: Original single baselines keep the original raw433 domain. New two-group receiver uses the explicitly bound mixed catalogue. Both digests are registered separately.
physical_and_logical_identity.channel: contract.standard_noise and contract.public_counter use source_id/selection_slot, estimated SNR, registered seed and cal200 namespace. True SNR scales the shared standard noise. Source image, original tokens and transmitted ID do not enter the RX function.

accounting.reservation: Immutable physical and actual packet reservations precede calls. Unknown failure preserves unresolved reservations and blocks automatic replay.
accounting.reuse: Only an already complete record with the identical full input identity can be reused inside the same journal. This worker does not reopen or automatically resume a historical attempt.
accounting.completion: COMPLETE_R1_PHY_ONLY is not reconstruction, metric, policy-selection or R2 completion. All those stages remain explicitly NOT_RUN.
accounting.successor: No automatic scientific successor is implemented by this worker.
